summary: Dependabot bump of actions/create-github-app-token from v3.3.0 (64ab729a) to v3.4.0 (f418cff3) in the attest job of the independent security gate (trusted-security-gate.yml), the step that mints the status-only installation token from SKIRNIR_GATE_PRIVATE_KEY. This is a change to the review system itself, so it is reviewed against the previous trusted version and flagged for the maintainer. Verified: the new SHA f418cff399f7aef4c2f0ad47e25ca7a6abbdd6fc is the commit the official tag v3.4.0 of actions/create-github-app-token points to (GitHub API git/ref/tags/v3.4.0, type commit); the reference stays pinned to a full SHA with the version comment (ADR-0055). Release notes of v3.4.0 (2026-11-18) list only dependency updates of the action itself (setup-node 6->7, stale 10->11, git-auto-commit-action 7.2.1 in its own workflows, undici bump) and no input/permission changes. The step's inputs (app-id, private-key, permission-statuses: write), the job's environment security-gate-publisher, its `if` condition and the publish step are unchanged; the token scope stays statuses:write only. The merge of main into the branch adds no further change relative to the new base.

tests.evidence: object type commit, sha f418cff399f7aef4c2f0ad47e25ca7a6abbdd6fc = the pinned SHA in the diff.
see PR checks; the reference is a full commit SHA with version comment.

limitations: The action's code between v3.3.0 and v3.4.0 was judged from its release notes and tag, not audited line by line.
The attest job only runs on the default branch after merge, so the new version is first exercised by the next PR's gate run.
